notes.title: We are a part of the Steam Space Exploration Fest! 👩‍🚀
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hello Androids! 🤖[/b][/h1]

[h3]We are very happy to be a part of this amazing event 🚀 and right now start your adventure as an android who is in charge of a spaceship colony in the [b]demo version[/b] now! 👇[/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1891250/Android_Simulator/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42286609/89bdb077880c8cbdd265f6789469abdd93ad5469.png[/img][/url]

[u]About This Event[/u]:
[b]Steam Space Exploration Fest[/b] celebrates games about spaaaaaace. Moons, planets, and galaxies far far away and the games that explore them are the focus of this event. ☄️

[h3]This event runs September 2 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7) to September 9 at 10:00 AM PDT (UTC-7)[/h3]


[h3]And don't forget to add the [b]Prologue[/b] to your [b]Steam Wishlist[/b] after playing the demo! 👇[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2025760/Android_Simulator_Prologue/

Have fun!
Android Simulator Team
